normalization: Exhaust provider pages, then sort by global log_index; reject duplicates, gaps and mixed identities. Remove only trailing null topics; retain four non-null ERC-721 topics. Address/address_hash identify the emitter; ignore smart_contract.
provider_failures: No retries. HTTP 401/403/429 or transport/cap failures stop unstarted calls; other transaction failures remain without replacement. At most two requests already in flight may finish.
purpose: Fixed ordinary-calendar-day development data-boundary exercise; not adjudicated negative traffic or independent attack test
source_population_limit: The sample contains only transactions in the previously archived Euler core emitter stream. Compare all provider core payloads with the archive; non-core logs lack independent receipt verification.
status_interpretation: Provider status ok/error maps to 1/0. Unknown or pending status is unavailable, not zero flow. Indexer metadata and pagination are not raw RPC receipts or root proofs.
